cohort: Mothers and infants in tornado-affected counties in Alabama and Joplin, Missouri, from 2010-2012
finding: While prenatal exposure to tornadoes was not associated with adverse birth weight or infant mortality, it was linked to an increased likelihood of cesarean sections in Joplin, Missouri.
mod_finding: Prenatal exposure to tornadoes was linked to an increased likelihood of cesarean sections in Joplin, Missouri.
